description: `platform.changes` (S54 T1's ledger, read by T2's door) answers the derived-store operation audit newest first: who started what act, on which root, when. Rows are the STARTED acts (SP3: one platform_change row per operation actually queued, written in the same transaction — not attempts, not outcomes). op is the closed four {reindex, graph_build, graph_reparse, graph_delete}; a reindex row's subject is the flight's own key, root and corpus joined by NUL (one identity across ledger, audit and single-flight), shown here as \u0000; actor_kind is the closed pair {user, cli} the audit CHECK compiled (no agent has a door onto these acts, SP4); outcomeRef is the worker id minted for the attempt ('aw_…' or absent — never prose). subject filters by root; an empty subject lists the plane. A read: it audits nothing, carries no identity param, reaches only the person's socket.
